title: Consent configuration deployment correction
summary: Corrected the account-lifecycle readiness gate to consume the source-controlled consent configuration namespace used by production environment values.
changes: Aligned account preflight with the configured consent policy version and privacy notice URL so valid production settings are recognized during activation.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch correcting the pre-switch deployment gate before the public lifecycle cutover.
validation: Account readiness tests use the production consent namespace and cover valid configuration, missing legal configuration, collisions, and post-migration defaults.
known_limitations: Registration, onboarding, service gating, and explicit identity linking remain disabled until the following compatible releases.
rollback: The previous release remains compatible with the additive account-lifecycle schema; database migrations stay forward-only and no user data is removed.
provenance: Defined by the pre-switch v0.9.1 production activation failure for MyAPES Account issue #19.
